step.cmd: In RCM, amend the ROE from the bankrupt employer to include the dividend payments.

In SSO, recalculate the claim, but do not transmit the transactions that are generated. Send the recalculation to IPOC using an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction. After reviewing the transactions generated during the calculation of the claim, store any of the transactions created by SSO before proceeding to step 3. For more information on recalculating claims, refer to the appropriate activity to calculate or recalculate the claim.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change the registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: When you receive the details of the OP amount from IPOC, advise the Regional Bankruptcy Coordinator of the amount OP according to regional procedures.
In ACS, create and send a D-20-16-03 letter to each affected client. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:
